description: Shared menu catalog. Single source of truth for menu structure, labels, icons, help tips, e-paper styles, and web field metadata. The e-paper board and the React web UI each render this through their own renderer; inherently dynamic menus (device scans, engine/player lists) stay code-driven but read their chrome (label/icon/help) from here.

time_control_presets.label: Basic
time_control_presets.description: No preset. Use the Base Minutes control to set a simple sudden-death clock (the same time for both sides, no increment or delay).

time_control_presets.label: Untimed
time_control_presets.description: No clock; the display shows only whose turn it is.

time_control_presets.label: 1|0 Bullet
time_control_presets.description: 1 minute per side, no increment.

time_control_presets.label: 1|1 Bullet
time_control_presets.description: 1 minute per side plus 1 second added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 2|1 Bullet
time_control_presets.description: 2 minutes per side plus 1 second added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 3|0 Blitz
time_control_presets.description: 3 minutes per side, no increment.

time_control_presets.label: 3|2 Blitz
time_control_presets.description: 3 minutes per side plus 2 seconds added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 5|0 Blitz
time_control_presets.description: 5 minutes per side, no increment.

time_control_presets.label: 5|3 Blitz
time_control_presets.description: 5 minutes per side plus 3 seconds added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 10|0 Rapid
time_control_presets.description: 10 minutes per side, no increment.

time_control_presets.label: 10|5 Rapid
time_control_presets.description: 10 minutes per side plus 5 seconds added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 15|10 Rapid
time_control_presets.description: 15 minutes per side plus 10 seconds added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 30|0 Classical
time_control_presets.description: 30 minutes per side, no increment.

time_control_presets.label: 30|20 Classical
time_control_presets.description: 30 minutes per side plus 20 seconds added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 60|30 Classical
time_control_presets.description: 60 minutes per side plus 30 seconds added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 90|30 Classical
time_control_presets.description: 90 minutes per side plus 30 seconds added each move.

time_control_presets.label: 5 min + 3s Delay
time_control_presets.description: 5 minutes per side; the clock waits 3 seconds each move before counting down (US delay).

time_control_presets.label: 5 min + 3s Bronstein
time_control_presets.description: 5 minutes per side; up to 3 seconds of the time used each move is given back (Bronstein delay).

time_control_presets.label: 40/90 + 30 (Tournament)
time_control_presets.description: 40 moves in 90 minutes, then 30 minutes for the rest, with 30 seconds added each move (FIDE classical).

time_control_presets.label: 40/120, 20/60, 30 (Tournament)
time_control_presets.description: 40 moves in 120 minutes, then 20 moves in 60 minutes, then 30 minutes for the rest.

time_control_presets.label: Custom
time_control_presets.description: Build your own clock: base time, Fischer increment, delay (simple or Bronstein), and optionally different times for each side (time odds).

nodes.label: Delay Mode
nodes.help: None: no delay. Simple: the clock waits before counting down. Bronstein: used time is given back, up to the delay.

nodes.label: Different Per Side

nodes.help: Engine used for position analysis (best changed between games).

nodes.label: Analysis Time
nodes.help: How long the board's engine analyses each position for its evaluation. Longer is more accurate (closer to the web's number) but uses more CPU and battery.

nodes.label: Coach
nodes.help: Coaching personality and style. Auto matches the coach to the opponent's rating; independent of the agent that powers it.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.help: Which AI agent powers the coach. Only agents with an API key and all required settings are listed; configure them under Settings > Agents. Greyed out while the Coach is Disabled.

nodes.label: Candidate lines
nodes.help: Number of engine candidate moves the coach considers for a move. Higher values let it suggest alternatives but cost extra analysis; 1 disables alternatives.

nodes.label: Ponder
nodes.help: Let engine opponents think on your time. Improves engine play but continuously runs a dedicated engine process, using more CPU and power (best on a mains-powered board, not battery).
